commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before &&
   [ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   [ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before; then
  :
else
  echo "SNAP_FAILED"; printf '%s\n' disabled > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled
fi

git show f36798e3a2f3bb8548725aa7713a97f7d6683f6a:lib/generate-capability-profiles.py > /tmp/gen.py
git show f36798e3a2f3bb8548725aa7713a97f7d6683f6a:lib/capability-profiles.json > /tmp/cap.json
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import json, hashlib
m=json.load(open('cap.json'))
prof=m['profiles']['command'] if 'profiles' in m else None
print('keys:', list(m.keys()))
"

git show f36798e3a2f3bb8548725aa7713a97f7d6683f6a:lib/capability-profiles.json > /tmp/cap.json; python3 -c "
import json
m=json.load(open('/tmp/cap.json'))
print(list(m.keys()))
"

git show f36798e3a2f3bb8548725aa7713a97f7d6683f6a:lib/generate-capability-profiles.py > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/gen.py
git show f36798e3a2f3bb8548725aa7713a97f7d6683f6a:lib/capability-profiles.json > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/cap.json
python3 -c "
import json, hashlib, re
m=json.load(open('/home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/cap.json'))
print('top keys:', list(m.keys()))
"
